ritual fire offering; object in series

items.question: Which additional ritual observances must be carried out at the appointed time?
premises: Food-offering, fire-oblation, festival, and dance are prescribed ritual observances.
These observances are to be performed at the proper time.
The prescribed agent should duly carry out these ritual acts.
items.inference: Therefore food-offering, fire-oblation, festival, and dance should be performed at the appointed time.
uncertainties: The forms bali and homa are morphologically ambiguous between nominative and accusative singular; they are taken as accusative objects in parallel with utsavaṃ and nṛttaṃ.
items.plain_english: One should perform the food offering, the fire oblation, the festival, and the dance at the proper time.
